title: Rectangle visible left-half window management

instructions: In the visible disposable VM, grant Rectangle Accessibility permission if macOS requests it, then relaunch Rectangle if required.
Open one Finder window on the desktop and keep it away from any full-screen Space.
Use the Rectangle menu-bar menu and choose Left Half; do not resize the Finder window manually.
Open Rectangle Settings > Layout and show the configured 5 point gaps before retaining the visual artifact.
acceptance: The Rectangle Left Half action visibly moves and resizes the Finder window to the left half of the usable display.
A visible gap remains at the configured display and split edges, and Rectangle Settings > Layout shows 5 point gaps.
The retained screenshot or video shows the resulting window placement and enough Rectangle UI to identify the action or configured gap.

artifact.description: Operator-captured Rectangle window-management result in the disposable VM.

cleanup: Quit Rectangle and close the test Finder window.
After copying the run directory to the host, stop and delete the disposable UTM clone.
Delete failed run directories; retain a successful run directory only when its finalized manifest will retain those artifacts.
